title: Count the total parts
text: First, count the total number of equal parts the shape is divided into. This will be your denominator.

title: Count the shaded parts
text: Next, count only the parts that are shaded. This will be your numerator.

title: Write the fraction
text: Place the number of shaded parts over the total number of parts: $$\frac{\text{shaded}}{\text{total}}$$ (2 shaded over $$9$$ total).
